# Kaggwe Marvin: Notes

> Notes, tutorials and projects by Kaggwe Marvin Victor, a full-stack developer in Kampala, Uganda. This is his blog-first site. His full resume is at https://kaggwe-marvin.github.io/Personal-Resume/, which is also the original home of the posts below.

## About the author

- Name: Kaggwe Marvin Victor (also written Marvin Kaggwe)
- Role: Full-Stack Developer, Kampala, Uganda
- Education: Bachelor of Business Computing, Makerere University Business School, graduating February 2027 (CGPA 3.95/5.0)
- Skills: Python, Django, TypeScript, SQL, GitHub Actions, MikroTik RouterOS, Linux
- Open to junior developer, business systems and IT roles
- Contact: kaggwemarvin@gmail.com, https://github.com/kaggwe-marvin

## Pages

- [Home](https://kaggwemarvinvictor.me/): introduction, latest posts and featured projects

## Posts

- [Why I'm drawn to neobrutalism, and how I toned it down](https://kaggwe-marvin.github.io/Personal-Resume/blog/why-neobrutalism/): why he chose neobrutalist design for this site, and the contrast fixes he made to it (dark text on amber, lighter shadows in dark mode).
- [Why I built Voucher Manager: printing hotspot vouchers on RouterOS 7](https://kaggwe-marvin.github.io/Personal-Resume/blog/voucher-manager-routeros-7/): RouterOS 7 User Manager needs five manual steps to produce printable vouchers (create users, attach a profile to each, run generate-voucher on exactly those users, fetch the generated HTML from um5files/PRIVATE/GENERATED/vouchers/, print). Voucher Manager does all five through the RouterOS API.
- [Run Linux on Windows 10 or Tiny10 with MSYS2 and QEMU](https://kaggwe-marvin.github.io/Personal-Resume/blog/msys2-qemu-linux-setup/): install QEMU in the MSYS2 MINGW64 environment, use -accel whpx (or -accel tcg -cpu max), forward port 2222 to SSH, and run it in the background without -daemonize, which Windows does not support.
- [How I built my first site: from Hugo to Zola](https://kaggwe-marvin.github.io/Personal-Resume/blog/how-i-built-this-site/): lessons from moving a personal site from Hugo and hugo-coder to Zola with a custom template.

## Software

- [Voucher Manager](https://github.com/kaggwe-marvin/Voucher-Manager): free Windows 10/11 app for MikroTik RouterOS 7 User Manager hotspot vouchers. Download: https://kaggwemarvinvictor.me/projects/
